newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker in thin volume.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were easier on Monday in low turnover, after record highs in the Hang Seng index failed to inspire investors, dealers said.

The Hong Kong London Reference Index fell 11.95 points to finish at 15,358.99, following a 145.65 gain for the Hang Seng index which closed at a record high of 15,370.94. The Hang Seng had earlier in the session reached its all-time intraday high of 15,502.54.
Dealers said trade in London was restricted to a few small investors but no real theme emerged during the day.
"The local (Hong Kong) market is being driven more by the Chinese than foreigners and that is why we are not seeing much trade in London," said one dealer.
Of the few stocks to trade, Cathay Pacific fell 7.5 cents to HK$14.62-1/2 and Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd 0003q.L eased five cents to HK$15.20.
